You are an expert R package developer and senior quantitative researcher specializing in clinical causal inference and observational retrospective cohort studies.

Your task is to refactor, standardize, and polish the IndepAssoc R package based on the updated specification provided in IndepAssoc_Recommendation_Plan/OpenCode_Plan.md.

Key Execution Objectives:

  1. Folder Consolidation & Data Architecture Clean-up:
    • Eliminate redundant data folders (such as rhc_data/).
    • Move all raw data downloading and parsing scripts into data-raw/ (e.g., data-raw/prepare_rhc.R, data-raw/simulate_example_cohort.R).
    • Process raw clinical data into optimized, documented binary .rda objects saved under data/ (example_cohort.rda, rhc_sample.rda).
    • Place data parsing logic into R/data_helpers.R (e.g., prepare_rhc_data()), correctly handling literal "NA" character strings versus missingness (such as the cat2 column in RHC), recoding binary exposures, and filtering heavy missingness features (adld3p, urin1).
  2. Core Estimator & Robustness Refactoring:
    • Matching Estimator Correction: Ensure fit_outcome(..., method = "matching") uses conditional logistic regression (survival::clogit()) conditioned on match_num/strata for binary outcomes, matching the methodology from the CABG and LAAC/POAF source papers.
    • Defensive Modeling: Wrap mixed-effects modeling in fit_all_models() with tryCatch() to gracefully log warnings and return NA on constant-response subsets rather than throwing a fatal error.
    • Reproducibility: Add an explicit seed argument across run_pipeline() and match_cohort() to ensure 100% deterministic matching across runs.
  3. Humanize & Elevate Package Documentation:
    • Audit all vignettes (vignettes/), README.md, NEWS.md, and Roxygen2 headers across R/.
    • Remove all mechanical AI writing tropes and buzzwords (e.g., “delve”, “pivotal”, “testament”, “realm”, “vital role”, “in conclusion”).
    • Rewrite documentation in a clear, authoritative, and direct tone appropriate for a Senior Healthcare Data Scientist. Frame the documentation around clinical decision-making, epidemiological confounder control, and methodological trade-offs between the 5 methods (regression, matching, stratification, iptw, aipw).
    • Ensure the RHC validation vignette (vignettes/rhc-validation.Rmd) compares directional results against established clinical literature (Connors et al. 1996) with clear causal caveat disclaimers.
  4. Quality Assurance:
    • Run unit tests (devtools::test()) and ensure coverage across all 5 adjustment methods.
    • Run devtools::check() and ensure R CMD check passes cleanly with 0 Errors, 0 Warnings, and 0 Notes.

Execute these updates phase by phase, committing changes after each logical stage.
